ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; approximately 98% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels on the primary fluke surface contrasted against <2% high-intensity white/beige pixels at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous black pigmentation across the central, medial, and proximal fluke regions. High-contrast, heterogeneous beige and white clusters forming irregular geometric shapes are localized exclusively at the left and right distal lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an acute interior angle; notch depth is approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Medial trailing edge exhibits low-amplitude, high-frequency micro-serrations; the distal 15% of each lobe edge transitions to high-amplitude, irregular jagged topography corresponding to biological encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curve fitted to the trailing edge, sweeping upward from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly dense, multi-layered clusters of circular high-contrast pixel groups (barnacle colonies) concentrated at the terminal points of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant biological encrustation (barnacles) at both lobe tips, creating a bulbous, irregular termination of the fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Vertical streams of water droplets (motion-blurred high-intensity pixels) falling from multiple points along the trailing edge and distal tips.
